An organization primarily funded by the government of Belgium, it supports scientific research across various disciplines, providing grants and fellowships to researchers and scholars. It plays a crucial role in advancing knowledge and innovation within the country, contributing to scientific progress on both national and international levels.

Jobomschrijving

Job Function

The hired individual will be attached to the International and Institutional Affairs Department – Mobility and Congress, primarily responsible for administrative management of the department.

Tasks

Administering the management of the department's email inquiries and secretarial tasks.

Processing various documents.

Providing administrative support to team members.

Receive briefings and requests for content creation from the various stakeholders in the organisation

Plan the copy work and communicate clear deadlines to the stakeholders, taking into account potential back-and-forth and validation.

Create content in line with the Thalys tone of voice and internal processes, taking account of SEO constraints

Ensuring that the content is validated by the various stakeholders before being sent to the translators

Reviewing the content once it has been translated and integrating it into our CMS according to the production process

Requirements:

Bachelor's degree in administration

Proficient written and spoken English (minimum B2 level)

Minimum 2 years of experience in administration

Excellent spelling and grammar

Ability to analyze and synthesize information

Organizational skills, attention to detail, dynamism, adaptability to priorities, and flexibility

Strong interpersonal skills and ability to work in a team

Proficiency in computer tools (MS Office)

Knowledge of the academic and research world

Contract of limited duration of 1 year

jobs.occupation: Sales Executive Benelux - Watches Industry (Dutch Native)
jobs.description:
Our client is a distinguished leader in the fine watch and luxury industry, renowned for craftsmanship and timeless excellence.They are now looking for a driven Sales Executive Benelux, capable of elevating their commercial network and fostering long-term relationships.

The Sales Executive Benelux will have the following responsibilities :

• Manage and develop relationships with the brand distribution network across the Benelux region.
• Conduct regular visits to points of sale to ensure operational excellence, identify improvement opportunities, and implement corrective actions.
• Build strong partnerships with retailers and act as the main point of contact for the brands.

• Dutch native, Fluent in French and English

jobs.occupation: Key Account Manager FMCG | Willing to relocate in Paris
jobs.description:
Our client is a leading international player in the Non-Food FMCG sector, recognized for its portfolio of strong consumer brands and its commitment to innovation, quality, and sustainable growth. Present across multiple European markets, the company partners with major retailers and continuously invests in developing its brands, people, and commercial capabilities.

Jobomschrijving

The Key Account Manager will have the following responsibilities :

• Develop and manage strategic relationships with key retail accounts across Belgium and Luxembourg.
• Lead annual commercial negotiations, including pricing, promotions, trade terms, and joint business plans.
• Identify growth opportunities and implement account strategies to achieve sales and profitability targets.
• Drive category expansion, product launches, and promotional activations with retail partners.
• Monitor sales performance, market trends, and competitor activity to recommend corrective actions and growth initiatives.
• Prepare forecasts, business reviews, and account performance analyses for internal and external stakeholders.
• Ensure excellence in customer management while maximizing brand visibility and market share.

• Minimum 5 years of experience in a Key Account Manager or similar commercial role within FMCG
• Proven experience negotiating with Belgian retail chains.
• Excellent negotiation and relationship-building skills.
• Analytical mindset with the ability to translate data into actionable business recommendations.
• Fluent in French & Dutch. English is a strong asset.
• Willingness to relocate to Paris.

Our client is a fast-growing organization active in the financial services sector. As part of its continued expansion, the company is investing heavily in digital transformation initiatives aimed at harmonizing processes, improving operational efficiency, and supporting the adoption of innovative technologies, including AI.

Jobomschrijving

As a Business Analyst, you will play a key role in the group's digital transformation journey. Working closely with business stakeholders and digital teams, you will analyze existing ways of working, identify improvement opportunities, and support the implementation of new tools and processes across multiple entities.This position is ideal for someone with a background in accounting or finance who has developed a strong interest in technology, process optimization, and digital transformation.Key responsibilities

• Analyze and document business processes across different entities.
• Identify opportunities for process improvement, standardization, and automation.
• Gather and challenge business requirements from key stakeholders.
• Act as the bridge between end-users, operational teams, and digital experts.
• Support the implementation and adoption of new digital solutions.
• Drive change management and promote best practices across the organization.
• Help users leverage new technologies and AI tools such as ChatGPT and Claude.
• Provide training and guidance to internal teams on digital tools and new ways of working.
• Monitor user feedback and propose continuous improvements.

• 3 to 5 years of professional experience as a Business Analyst, Process Analyst, Functional Analyst or Digital Transformation Consultant.
• Alternatively, experience in accounting combined with strong exposure to digital tools and process improvement.
• Knowledge of accounting and financial workflows.
• Familiarity with accounting software or digital finance solutions is a strong advantage.
• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
• Curious about technology, AI, and innovation.
• Hands-on mindset and willingness to work in a fast-growing environment.
• Fluent in Dutch and English.
